import pytest

from flutils.setuputils import SetupCfgCommandConfig


def test_SetupCfgCommandConfig():
    obj = SetupCfgCommandConfig(
        name='test',
        camel='Test',
        description='a test command',
        commands=('ls -al',)
    )
    assert obj.name == 'test'
    assert obj.camel == 'Test'
    assert obj.description == 'a test command'
    assert obj.commands == ('ls -al',)


def test_SetupCfgCommandConfig_attributes():
    obj = SetupCfgCommandConfig(
        name='build',
        camel='Build',
        description='',
        commands=('python setup.py build', 'python setup.py bdist_wheel')
    )
    assert obj._fields == ('name', 'camel', 'description', 'commands')
    assert obj[0] == 'build'
    assert obj[1] == 'Build'
    assert obj[2] == ''
    assert obj[3] == ('python setup.py build', 'python setup.py bdist_wheel')


def test_SetupCfgCommandConfig_replace():
    obj = SetupCfgCommandConfig(
        name='test',
        camel='Test',
        description='a test command',
        commands=('ls -al',)
    )
    obj2 = obj._replace(name='other')
    assert obj2.name == 'other'
    assert obj2.camel == 'Test'
    assert obj2.description == 'a test command'
    assert obj2.commands == ('ls -al',)

    import tempfile
    import shutil

    tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(tmpdir, 'setup.py'), 'w') as f:
            f.write('# setup.py\n')
        with open(os.path.join(tmpdir, 'setup.cfg'), 'w') as f:
            f.write(
                '[metadata]\n'
                'name = my_pkg\n'
                '\n'
                '[setup.command.build]\n'
                'command = python setup.py build\n'
                '\n'
                '[setup.command.test]\n'
                'name = run-tests\n'
                'description = run the tests for {name}\n'
                'commands =\n'
                '    python -m pytest\n'
                '\n'
                '[setup.command.bad-name!]\n'
                'command = nothing\n'
            )
        results = list(each_sub_command_config(tmpdir))
        assert results == [
            SetupCfgCommandConfig(
                'build',
                'Build',
                '',
                ('python setup.py build',),
            ),
            SetupCfgCommandConfig(
                'run-tests',
                'RunTests',
                'run the tests for my_pkg',
                ('python -m pytest',),
            ),
        ], results
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
